definitions.explanation: The art of performing plays on stage; theatrical performances in general.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}で{演劇|えんげき}を{学|まな}んでいる。
{演劇|えんげき}{部|ぶ}に{入|はい}りたい。
examples.english: I want to join the drama club.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{演劇|えんげき}には{様々|さまざま}な{種類|しゅるい}がある。
examples.english: There are various types of drama in Japan.

notes:
USAGE: {演劇|えんげき} refers to theater and dramatic arts as a whole, including both performance and study.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{演劇|えんげき}{部|ぶ} (drama club)
・{演劇|えんげき}{祭|さい} (drama festival)
・{演劇|えんげき}{鑑賞|かんしょう} (watching plays)
・{演劇|えんげき}{界|かい} (the theater world)

JAPANESE TRADITIONAL THEATER:
・{歌舞伎|かぶき} (kabuki)
・{能|のう} (noh)
・{文楽|ぶんらく} (bunraku puppet theater)
・{狂言|きょうげん} (kyogen comedy)

RELATED:
・{劇|げき} - play, drama
・{芝居|しばい} - play, theatrical performance
・{舞台|ぶたい} - stage; theatrical performance
